question: 七月的毛利率
output:
{"type": "sql", "sql": "WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        dt, 
        sku_id,
        SUM(sales_qty) AS total_sales_qty,
        SUM(net_revenue) AS total_net_revenue,
        SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gross_amount,
        SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discount_amount
    FROM fact_sales_daily
    WHERE dt LIKE '2026-07-%'
    GROUP BY dt, sku_id
),
cost_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.dt,
        sd.sku_id,
        sd.total_sales_qty,
        sd.total_net_revenue,
        sd.total_gross_amount,
        sd.total_discount_amount,
        fsc.unit_cogs
    FROM sales_data sd
    JOIN fact_sku_cost_monthly fsc ON sd.sku_id = fsc.sku_id 
        AND sd.dt >= fsc.month 
        AND sd.dt < fsc.month || '-01'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_net_revenue) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(total_gross_amount) AS total_gross,
        SUM(total_discount_amount) AS total_discount,
        SUM(total_sales_qty * unit_cogs) AS total_cost
    FROM cost_data
)
SELECT 
    total_revenue,
    total_cost,
    total_discount,
    total_gross,
    (total_revenue - total_cost) / total_revenue AS gross_margin_ratio
FROM aggregated;"}

        fsd.dt AS sale_date,
        SUM(fsd.sales_qty * fscm.unit_cogs) AS total_product_cost
    FROM fact_sales_daily fsd
    JOIN fact_sku_cost_monthly fscm ON fsd.sku_id = fscm.sku_id 
        AND fsd.dt >= fscm.month AND fsd.dt < fscm.month || '-01'
    WHERE fsd.dt >= '2026-09-01' AND fsd.dt <= '2026-09-30'
    GROUP BY fsd.dt
),
logistics_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(logistics_cost) AS total_logistics_cost
    FROM fact_logistics_daily
    WHERE dt >= '2026-09-01' AND dt <= '2026-09-30'
),
commission_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(commission_amount) AS total_commission
    FROM fact_commission_monthly
    WHERE month = '2026-09'
),
marketing_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(amount) AS total_marketing_cost
    FROM fact_marketing_monthly
    WHERE month = '2026-09'
)
SELECT 
    ss.total_sales_qty,
    ss.total_gross_amount,
    ss.total_discount_amount,
    ss.total_net_revenue,
    cs.total_product_cost,
    ls.total_logistics_cost,
    COALESCE(cms.total_commission, 0) AS total_commission,
    COALESCE(mms.total_marketing_cost, 0) AS total_marketing_cost,
    (ss.total_net_revenue - cs.total_product_cost - ls.total_logistics_cost - COALESCE(cms.total_commission, 0) - COALESCE(mms.total_marketing_cost, 0)) / ss.total_net_revenue AS net_profit_margin,
    ss.total_discount_amount / ss.total_gross_amount AS discount_rate
FROM sales_summary ss
JOIN cost_summary cs ON ss.sale_date = cs.sale_date
JOIN logistics_summary ls ON 1=1
JOIN commission_summary cms ON 1=1
JOIN marketing_summary mms ON 1=1
GROUP BY ss.total_sales_qty, ss.total_gross_amount, ss.total_discount_amount, ss.total_net_revenue, cs.total_product_cost, ls.total_logistics_cost, cms.total_commission, mms.total_marketing_cost;
"}
